description.value: The Penticton Museum & Archives is a free civic museum operated by the City of Penticton, situated in the heart of downtown along Main Street. It offers exhibits, family programs, museum tours, and archival resources exploring the history of the South Okanagan region. Touring cyclists passing through Penticton's downtown core will find it a no-cost cultural stop in a community renowned for its cycling routes.
